name: English

strings.整个界面（标题栏、标签页、工具栏、侧栏、对话框）的外观，与首页样式互不绑定；阅读: Look of the whole interface (title bar, tabs, toolbars, side panels, dialogs). Independent of the home page style; the reading area is not affected. Applies immediately.
strings.深绿框架，琥珀选中，错版阴影: Deep-green frame, amber selection, offset-print shadows
strings.磨砂半透明，圆角，柔光边: Frosted translucent panels, rounded corners, soft glowing edges
strings.厚错版阴影，直角，等宽标签: Thick offset shadows, square corners, monospaced labels
strings.纸张与文件夹标签，衬线标题: Paper and folder tabs, serif headings
strings.零圆角，实心大色块，深色缝隙: No rounded corners, solid colour blocks, dark gaps
strings.7 页功能导览，可随意批注: A 7-page feature tour you can annotate freely
strings.Excel XLSX · 表格 / 逐行文本: Excel XLSX · tables / text by line
strings.PDF 与 Markdown 文档将在新标签页中打开: PDF and Markdown documents open in new tabs
strings.Pandoc 路径（留空则自动查找）: Pandoc path (leave empty to detect automatically)
strings.Pandoc（可选，用于 ODT / RST / PPTX 等格式及导入）: Pandoc (optional, for ODT / RST / PPTX and importing)
strings.Word DOCX · 可编辑文本与图片: Word DOCX · editable text and images
strings.Word、ePub、LaTeX、RTF、HTML、PDF、图片、纯文本由青页自己: Word, ePub, LaTeX, RTF, HTML, PDF, images and plain text are generated by Qingye itself and do not need Pandoc.
strings.· 直接输入 Markdown，块内实时显示格式；Ctrl+/ 切换源码模式。\:
· Type Markdown directly; formatting shows live inside the block. Ctrl+/ toggles source mode.
· Ctrl+Shift+P opens the command palette to search every command; Ctrl+P opens files quickly.
· Switch "Read / Edit / Source" at the top right: Read shows the layout only; double-click the text or press E to edit.
· F8 focus mode, F9 typewriter mode.
· Click inside a table for the table toolbar; click an image to resize it.
· All shortcuts can be changed in "Preferences → Shortcuts".
· Open "Help → Markdown syntax reference" to see all syntax.
strings.· 请保存为 .md 文件: · please save it as a .md file
strings.“{name}”的页面编辑尚未应用。是否放弃并继续？: The page edit in "{name}" has not been applied. Discard it and continue?
strings.。处理并导出副本不会覆盖源文件。: . Processing and exporting a copy never overwrites the source file.
strings.不联网、不上传、无账号: No network, no upload, no account
strings.与另一个已打开文档并排阅读: Read side by side with another open document
strings.中文按字计数，英文按词计数；代码与公式也计入。按 Esc 关闭。: Chinese is counted by character, English by word; code and formulas are included. Press Esc to close.
strings.今天想读点什么？: What would you like to read today?
strings.从文档中删除此图片引用: Remove this image reference from the document
strings.从最近列表中移除（不删除文件）: Remove from recent list (the file is not deleted)
strings.使用 AES-256。打开密码可留空；管理密码必须填写且与打开密码不同。权限限制: Uses AES-256. The open password may be empty; the owner password is required and must differ from the open password. Permission limits depend on the reader honoring them.
strings.使用 {page} 与 {total} 作为页码占位符，框选页眉或页脚区域。: Use {page} and {total} as page-number placeholders; select the header or footer area.
strings.保存时在文末保证一个换行符: Ensure a trailing newline when saving
strings.保存时在文末添加空行: Add a trailing blank line when saving
strings.关闭时仍在打开的文档会在下次启动时重新打开。: Documents still open at exit are reopened at the next start.
strings.列表显示前 300 处；上一个 / 下一个可遍历全部命中。: The list shows the first 300 matches; Previous / Next go through all of them.
strings.删除框选区域内文字、图像及相交图形，同时清理元数据、附件、脚本，并扁平化批注与表: Deletes text, images and intersecting shapes in the selected area, cleans metadata, attachments and scripts, and flattens annotations and forms. Check the area and nearby content after exporting.
strings.删除框选区域内的原文字，再写入替换文本。不是 Word 式段落编辑；字体和布局可: Deletes the original text in the selected area and writes the replacement. This is not Word-style paragraph editing; fonts and layout may change.
strings.双击正文或按 E 开始编辑。: Double-click the text or press E to start editing.
strings.回到上次阅读的位置: Return to the last reading position
strings.图表库未输出 SVG。: The diagram library produced no SVG.
strings.在大纲中高亮当前标题: Highlight the current heading in the outline
strings.在所选页面的框选区域写入文字水印，可调整透明度。: Writes a text watermark into the selected area on the chosen pages; opacity is adjustable.
strings.在新窗口中打开当前文档: Open the current document in a new window
strings.在框选区域写入带边框的文字印章，不是证书数字签名。: Writes a bordered text stamp into the selected area. This is not a certificate-based digital signature.
strings.在框选区域创建可填写的文本或复选框字段，字段名按页码区分。: Creates fillable text or checkbox fields in the selected area; field names are distinguished by page number.
strings.在框选区域绘制图形；直线连接区域的左上与右下。: Draws a shape in the selected area; a line connects its top-left and bottom-right corners.
strings.复制所有本地图片到文档文件夹…: Copy all local images to the document folder…
strings.字号应在 6–100 之间，请修改后重试。: Font size must be between 6 and 100; please change it and try again.
strings.完全本地转换。DOCX 导出可编辑文字与图片；XLSX 识别表格；PPTX 为页: Fully local conversion. DOCX exports editable text and images; XLSX detects tables; PPTX uses page images. Complex layouts and formulas are not guaranteed to be faithful.
strings.实际 PDF 预览 · 尚未应用；拖动框或更改文字后自动更新: Actual PDF preview · not applied yet; updates after you move the box or change the text
strings.对已有文字的页面也重新 OCR: Re-run OCR on pages that already have text
strings.对框选区域添加可被其他阅读器识别的标准 PDF 批注。: Adds standard PDF annotations to the selected area that other readers can recognize.
strings.导出逐页文字或图像差异 HTML。页差用于对齐不同封面页；图像比较按左上角对齐，: Exports a page-by-page text or image difference report (HTML). The page offset aligns different cover pages; image comparison aligns at the top-left, so font antialiasing and layout shifts also show up as differences.
strings.将另一个已打开 PDF 的指定页面缩放到框选区域，作为矢量页面印章。: Scales the chosen pages of another open PDF into the selected area as a vector page stamp.
strings.将图片文件移到回收站…: Move image file to Recycle Bin…
strings.将批注、可视签名和表单外观写入页面，不再作为可编辑批注或字段。: Writes annotations, visible signatures and form appearances into the page; they are no longer editable annotations or fields.
strings.将本地图片作为印章写入框选区域，默认保持图片比例、在框内居中，不是证书数字签名。: Writes a local image into the selected area as a stamp, keeping its proportions and centered by default. This is not a certificate-based digital signature.
strings.将框选区域设为 PDF 页面的 CropBox。区域外内容仍在文件中；删除敏感内: Sets the selected area as the page's CropBox. Content outside stays in the file; use permanent redaction to remove sensitive content.
strings.将页面的明暗映射到所选背景与文字颜色；页面图像与批注也会参与配色。: Maps the page's light and dark to the chosen background and text colors; page images and annotations are recolored too.
strings.已保存到本机印章库: Saved to the local stamp library
strings.已保存过的文件按间隔自动保存。: Files that have been saved before are saved automatically at an interval.
strings.已保留当前内容；保存时会再次确认是否覆盖。: Kept your current content; saving will ask again before overwriting.
strings.已在资源管理器中显示链接的文件: The linked file was shown in Explorer
strings.已按格式粘贴（Ctrl+Shift+V 粘贴为纯文本）: Pasted with formatting (Ctrl+Shift+V pastes plain text)
strings.已注册为 PDF 与 Markdown 的打开方式: Registered as an app for opening PDF and Markdown
strings.已载入磁盘上的最新版本: Loaded the latest version from disk
strings.序列图库不可用。: The sequence diagram library is unavailable.
strings.开源 · 本地阅读 · 无会员\n多标签、搜索、目录、高亮、文本、墨迹与签名。\:
Open source · local reading · no membership
Tabs, search, outline, highlights, text, ink and signatures.
Reading engine: Mozilla PDF.js 6.3.289.
This version is open source under AGPL-3.0.
strings.当前文档有未保存修改（包括批注）。历史保留最近 20 次文档操作，上限 128: The current document has unsaved changes (including annotations). History keeps the last 20 document operations, up to 128 MB.
strings.当前文档没有未保存修改。: The current document has no unsaved changes.
strings.当前页码，输入后按回车跳转: Current page; type a number and press Enter to jump
strings.当前页面编辑尚未应用。是否放弃并继续？: The current page edit has not been applied. Discard it and continue?
strings.打开 PDF 或 Markdown 文档 · Ctrl+O: Open a PDF or Markdown document · Ctrl+O
strings.打开 Windows 的“选择打开方式”窗口，选中青页 PDF 并勾选“始终使用: Opens Windows' "Open with" window; choose Qingye PDF and tick "Always use"
strings.打开一个 PDF 或 Markdown，或者先看看右侧的示例。: Open a PDF or Markdown file, or try one of the samples on the right.
strings.打开已有文件时先进入阅读模式: Open existing files in Read mode first
strings.打开已有文件时先进入阅读模式（双击或按 E 开始编辑）: Open existing files in Read mode first (double-click or press E to edit)
strings.把 PDF 或 Markdown 拖进窗口任意位置即可打开: Drag a PDF or Markdown file anywhere into the window to open it
strings.把青页注册为 PDF 与 Markdown 文件的打开程序，双击文件即可在青页中: Register Qingye as the app for PDF and Markdown files so double-clicking a file opens it in Qingye. Windows 10/11 do not let programs change default apps directly: after registering, choose "Qingye PDF" in the system window that appears and confirm "Always use".
strings.拖动框移动，拖动右下角缩放；自动生成实际 PDF 预览。: Drag the box to move it and its corner to resize; an actual PDF preview is generated automatically.
strings.按 AGPL-3.0 开源，无账号、无会员次数配额。: Open source under AGPL-3.0, no account, no usage quotas.
strings.按原 PDF 方向预览。拖动框选区域；相同相对位置应用到指定页。: Previews in the PDF's original orientation. Drag to select an area; the same relative position is applied to the chosen pages.
strings.按所填页码重排 / 复制页面: Reorder / duplicate pages by the page list
strings.按文档记忆，不改动原文: Remembered per document; the original is not changed
strings.换行符将在下次保存时改为: Line endings will change at the next save to
strings.插入本地图片时：不处理: When inserting local images: do nothing
strings.插入本地图片时：复制到 ./assets 文件夹: When inserting local images: copy to ./assets
strings.插入本地图片时：复制到 ./文档名.assets 文件夹: When inserting local images: copy to ./<document name>.assets
strings.插入本地图片时：复制到自定义文件夹…: When inserting local images: copy to a custom folder…
strings.搜索表情，如 smile、heart、rocket: Search emoji, e.g. smile, heart, rocket
strings.操作未完成，请重试。: Operation not completed, please try again.
strings.文字阅读视图 · 按 PDF 文字顺序提取，不保留原页面图表与批注。: Text reading view · extracted in the PDF's text order, without the original figures and annotations.
strings.文档尚未就绪或正在处理。: The document is not ready or is being processed.
strings.文档没有内置目录。点击“编辑目录”可以添加章节与页码，并导出带目录的 PDF。: The document has no built-in outline. Click "Edit outline" to add sections and page numbers, and export a PDF with an outline.
strings.无法加载本地图表库：: Could not load the local diagram library:
strings.无法加载自定义主题：: Could not load the custom theme:
strings.无法读取图片区域：: Could not read the image area:
strings.无法读取文件关联状态。: Could not read the file association status.
strings.智能标点（仅渲染时转换引号、破折号，不改动源码）: Smart punctuation (quotes and dashes converted only when rendering; the source is unchanged)
strings.智能粘贴：把网页 / Word 中的格式转换为 Markdown: Smart paste: convert formatting from web pages / Word to Markdown
strings.暂无命中结果。扫描页需要先识别文字。: No matches yet. Scanned pages need text recognition first.
strings.暂无章节，点击“＋ 章节”或“自动识别标题”。: No sections yet. Click "＋ Section" or "Detect headings".
strings.未识别到文字，请尝试锐化或扫描优化。: No text recognized; try sharpening or scan optimization.
strings.未识别到标题。扫描页请先 OCR，也可手动添加。: No headings recognized. Run OCR on scanned pages first, or add them manually.
strings.本地、开源的 PDF 阅读器与 Markdown 编辑器。无账号、无会员、无广告: A local, open-source PDF reader and Markdown editor. No account, no membership, no ads. Open source under AGPL-3.0; third-party components and their licenses are listed in the bundled THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.
strings.本地中英文 OCR，识别页生成 200 DPI 图像与可搜索文字层。扫描质量影响: Local Chinese & English OCR; recognized pages get a 200 DPI image and a searchable text layer. Scan quality affects accuracy; please review the results.
strings.本地处理正在进行，完成后可保存。: Local processing is running; you can save when it finishes.
strings.本地处理正在进行，请完成后关闭文档。: Local processing is running; close the document when it finishes.
strings.本地处理正在进行，请等待完成后保存。: Local processing is running; please save after it finishes.
strings.本页没有可提取的文字。扫描件需要 OCR，请退出重新排布查看原页面。: No extractable text on this page. Scans need OCR; leave reflow to see the original page.
strings.标记图像差异（96 DPI，一次最多 200 页）: Mark image differences (96 DPI, up to 200 pages at once)
strings.标题栏右侧的月亮/太阳按钮可随时切换。: The moon/sun button on the right of the title bar switches it any time.
strings.正文字体（留空使用主题字体）: Body font (leave empty to use the theme font)
strings.此位置不能调整到该层级。: Cannot move to that level here.
strings.此命令在当前位置不可用: This command is not available here
strings.此操作需要选择一个其他文档。: This action requires choosing another document.
strings.此文件夹中没有 Markdown 文件。: There are no Markdown files in this folder.
strings.此文件已被其他程序修改，而青页中有未保存的修改。: This file was changed by another program, and Qingye has unsaved changes.
strings.每页拆成独立 PDF（ZIP）: Split each page into its own PDF (ZIP)
strings.没有标题。以 # 开头的行会出现在这里。: No headings. Lines starting with # appear here.
strings.清理未使用对象并压缩流、字体。可选图像降采样；无法变小时保留原始数据。: Removes unused objects and compresses streams and fonts. Optional image downsampling; keeps the original data when it cannot get smaller.
strings.清除首页“最近打开”列表，不会删除任何文件。: Clears the "Recent files" list on the home page; no files are deleted.
strings.源码模式 · Ctrl+/ 返回编辑: Source mode · Ctrl+/ to return to editing
strings.点击输入框后直接按下新的组合键；Backspace 清除（取消绑定）。与系统全局: Click an input and press the new key combination; Backspace clears it (unbinds). Combinations used by global app actions (such as save, new, find) are handled by the app and not listed here.
strings.点击页码多选；拖动卡片排序，处理后导出副本。: Click page numbers to multi-select; drag cards to reorder, then export a copy.
strings.用青页打开 PDF 和 Markdown: Open PDF and Markdown with Qingye
strings.相对文档或绝对路径：: Relative to the document or an absolute path:
strings.磁盘上的文件已被移动或删除。保存时会重新创建该文件，也可以另存为新文件。: The file on disk was moved or deleted. Saving will recreate it; you can also save as a new file.
strings.离线模式不加载网络图片：: Offline mode does not load web images:
strings.移除限制需填写管理密码: The owner password is required to remove restrictions
strings.第一次打开某个 PDF 时使用；之后按文件记忆。: Used the first time a PDF is opened; after that it is remembered per file.
strings.粘贴的剪贴板图片没有原文件，会按上面的位置保存（选择“不处理”时保存到 ./as: Pasted clipboard images have no source file and are saved to the location above ("do nothing" saves to ./assets). The document must be saved first.
strings.编辑模式 · 单击段落即可编辑: Edit mode · click a paragraph to edit it
strings.缩略图未加载，可点击打开页面。: Thumbnail not loaded; click to open the page.
strings.自动保存已有路径的文件: Automatically save files that have a path
strings.自动识别将替换当前目录草稿，请检查识别结果后再导出。: Detection replaces the current outline draft; check the result before exporting.
strings.自定义文件夹（相对文档或绝对路径）: Custom folder (relative to the document or absolute)
strings.菜单、按钮和提示使用的语言；文档内容不受影响。: Language of menus, buttons and messages; document content is not affected.
strings.覆盖将用青页中的当前内容替换磁盘上的版本；“另存为”可以同时保留两份。: Overwriting replaces the version on disk with the current content in Qingye; "Save as" keeps both.
strings.语法、公式、图表一页看完: Syntax, formulas and diagrams on one page
strings.请先保存当前批注，再在新窗口中打开。: Save the current annotations first, then open it in a new window.
strings.请先保存文档，再创建副本。: Save the document first, then create a copy.
strings.请先关闭文字重排，再编辑页面。: Turn off text reflow before editing pages.
strings.请先应用或取消当前页面编辑，再使用批注工具。: Apply or cancel the current page edit before using annotation tools.
strings.请先应用或取消当前页面编辑，再选择文字。: Apply or cancel the current page edit before selecting text.
strings.请先打开 PDF，或选择文件转换为 PDF: Open a PDF first, or choose files to convert to PDF
strings.请先打开另一个 PDF 文档。: Please open another PDF document first.
strings.请先注册为打开方式: Please register as default opener first
strings.请在 Windows 窗口中选择“青页 PDF”: Choose "Qingye PDF" in the Windows window
strings.请检查目录标题、页码与层级。: Please check the outline titles, pages and levels.
strings.请选择有效的文字颜色。: Please choose a valid text color.
strings.请选择有效的背景与文字颜色。: Please choose valid background and text colors.
strings.请选择至少一个待合并文档。: Please select at least one document to merge.
strings.读取本页原文块: Read text blocks on this page
strings.输入该 PDF 的管理密码后导出不加密副本；不会尝试破解密码。: Enter the PDF's owner password to export an unencrypted copy; no password cracking is attempted.
strings.还没有历史版本。每次保存都会为已保存的文件留下一个本地快照（最多保留 40 个，: No versions yet. Each save keeps a local snapshot of saved files (up to 40; identical content is not recorded twice).
strings.还没有可选文件：先打开一个文件夹，或打开过一些文档: No files to choose yet: open a folder first, or open some documents
strings.还没有打开文件夹。点击上方“打开文件夹”，文件树只显示 Markdown 文件。: No folder opened yet. Click "Open folder" above; the file tree only shows Markdown files.
strings.选择工具后打开一个 PDF 即可开始: Choose a tool, then open a PDF to start
strings.选择或拖动整段目录: Select or drag a whole outline branch
strings.选择文字；扫描页自动识别中英文: Select text; scanned pages are recognized automatically (Chinese & English)
strings.部分任务失败，可重试: Some tasks failed; you can retry
strings.重新打开 PDF 时跳到上次的页码和滚动位置。: Jump to the last page and scroll position when reopening a PDF.
strings.重新打开上次关闭时的标签: Reopen the tabs from the last session
strings.键入时检查拼写（使用系统拼写检查器）: Check spelling while typing (system spell checker)
strings.阅读书签保存在本机；要写入 PDF，请编辑“目录”。: Reading bookmarks are stored on this computer; to write them into the PDF, edit the "Outline".
strings.阅读引擎未初始化。: The reading engine is not initialized.
strings.阅读模式 · 双击正文或按 E 开始编辑: Read mode · double-click the text or press E to edit
strings.阅读模式：只看排版好的文档，不会误改内容: Read mode: see the formatted document only, without accidental edits
strings.阅读记录、草稿与 Markdown 版本历史所在位置。: Where reading history, drafts and Markdown version history are stored.
strings.阅读设置按文档记忆，不改动 PDF 原文。: Reading settings are remembered per document and never change the PDF.
strings.隐藏页面边缘，应用到本文件的全部页面。不会删除原文内容，保存与打印仍保留完整页面: Hides the page margins on every page of this file. No content is deleted; saving and printing keep the full pages. After rotation, margins follow the current display orientation.
strings.青页不联网、不上传文档。阅读位置、最近文件、草稿备份和偏好设置只保存在这台电脑上: Qingye never goes online or uploads documents. Reading positions, recent files, draft backups and preferences are stored only on this computer.
strings.页码可重复或倒序，例如 3,1-2,2。合并按列表中选中的文档顺序追加；原文件保: Pages may repeat or run backwards, e.g. 3,1-2,2. Merging appends documents in the order selected in the list; the original files are kept.
strings.页面排列、阅读配色、裁剪等视图设置在 PDF 工具栏的“视图”中，按文件分别记忆: Page layout, reading colors, cropping and other view settings are under "View" in the PDF toolbar and are remembered per file.
strings.页面编辑：添加文字、印章、图形: Page editing: add text, stamps and shapes
strings.首次启动完成，下次启动会明显变快: First launch finished; the next start will be much faster
strings.首行缩进两个字符: Indent the first line by two characters
strings.选择本地文档，转换为 Word、电子书、标记文本或 PDF。多个输入文件会合并为: Convert local documents to Word, ebooks, markup or PDF. Multiple input files are combined into one output document.
strings.例如 +smart-raw_html；留空使用默认扩展: For example +smart-raw_html; leave blank for defaults
strings.选项文件会添加到参数数组。自定义读写器可在此指定；Lua 过滤器会运行所选脚本。: Selected option files are added to the arguments. You can specify custom readers/writers here; Lua filters execute the selected scripts.
strings.转换由本机引擎完成。文档中的网络资源及网络参数可能产生下载请求，不使用云端转换服: Conversion runs locally. Online resources or network arguments may cause downloads; no cloud conversion service is used.
strings.自定义 Pandoc 路径（留空使用内置引擎）: Custom Pandoc path (blank uses built-in engine)
strings.Word / EPUB / Markdown / PDF · 内置转换引擎: Word / EPUB / Markdown / PDF · built-in converter
strings.PDF 使用青页内置排版，无需安装 TeX。与 LaTeX 排版的分页和样式可能: PDF uses built-in layout, without TeX installation. Page breaks and styles may differ from LaTeX.
strings.Pandoc PDF 需要外部排版器。请在高级参数指定已安装的 --pdf-en: Pandoc PDF requires an external layout engine. Specify an installed --pdf-engine in advanced arguments; missing engines will report errors.
strings.分章节 HTML 导出为 ZIP，内含完整输出目录。: Chunked HTML exports as a ZIP containing the complete output directory.
strings.请在高级参数通过 --to 指定 Lua 写出器或 Defaults 配置。: Specify a Lua writer using --to or a Defaults configuration in advanced arguments.
strings.本机处理、不使用云转换、无账号: Local processing, no cloud conversion, no account
strings.问问这份文档，或输入 / 选择预设: Ask about this document, or type / for presets
strings.Enter 发送 · Shift+Enter 换行 · AI 的回答可能出错，请: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · AI can make mistakes; check important information.
strings.修改不会自动保存，可以用 Ctrl+Z 撤销。: Changes are not saved automatically and can be undone with Ctrl+Z.
strings.用要点总结当前文档的主要内容，并注明对应的页码或章节。: Summarize the main points of the current document as bullet points, citing page numbers or sections.
strings.解释我选中的内容，必要时结合上下文。: Explain the text I selected, using the surrounding context where helpful.
strings.把选中的内容翻译成中文；如果原文是中文，就翻译成英文。保留原有格式。: Translate the selected text into English; if it is already English, translate it into Chinese. Keep the formatting.
strings.润色选中的文字，使表达更清晰流畅，保持原意，只输出修改后的版本。: Polish the selected text so it reads more clearly, keep its meaning, and output only the revised version.
strings.把当前文档整理成一份层级清晰的 Markdown 大纲。: Turn the current document into a clearly structured Markdown outline.
strings.根据文档内容出 5 道理解题，并在最后附上答案。: Write 5 comprehension questions about the document, with the answers at the end.
strings.根据上下文续写当前 Markdown 文档的下一段，风格保持一致。: Continue the current Markdown document with the next paragraph, in the same style.
strings.发送时附带选中内容（单击取消）: The selection is sent with your message (click to exclude)
strings.不附带选中内容（单击附带）: The selection is not sent (click to include)
strings.AI 可以通过工具读取当前文档: The AI can read the current document through tools
strings.文档工具已关闭：只发送文档开头的部分内容: Document tools are off: only the beginning of the document is sent
strings.支持 OpenAI 兼容接口（DeepSeek、通义千问、Kimi、智谱、硅基流: Works with OpenAI-compatible APIs (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Zhipu, SiliconFlow, OpenRouter and more), Anthropic, and Ollama / LM Studio on this computer. You can also import Open WebUI connection settings or a .env file.
strings.只有在你发送消息时，才会把问题和必要的文档片段发送到你配置的服务；API Key: Your question and the document excerpts it needs are sent to the service you configured only when you send a message. API keys are stored encrypted on this computer.
strings.打开一个文档开始协作: Open a document to get started
strings.已插入到光标处（Ctrl+Z 可撤销）: Inserted at the cursor (Ctrl+Z to undo)
strings.插入到光标处；有选中内容时替换选中内容: Insert at the cursor, or replace the selection if there is one
strings.填写服务地址和 API Key，或从 Open WebUI 的连接配置、.env: Enter a service URL and API key, or import from Open WebUI connection settings, a .env file or an exported JSON file. API keys are encrypted by the system and stored on this computer; only the last few characters are shown.
strings.粘贴 JSON、.env 内容（OPENAI_API_KEY=…、OPENAI_: Paste JSON, .env lines (OPENAI_API_KEY=…, OPENAI_BASE_URL=…) or "URL space key"
strings.允许 AI 使用文档工具: Let the AI use document tools
strings.让模型按需读取页面、搜索、查看目录和选中内容。模型不支持工具调用时会自动改为只发: The model reads pages, searches, and looks at the outline and selection as needed. If the model does not support tool calls, only the beginning of the document is sent.
strings.AI 修改文档前先确认: Confirm before the AI changes a document
strings.AI 写入 Markdown 前显示将要写入的内容，由你决定是否允许。: Shows what the AI is about to write into Markdown and lets you decide.
strings.越低越稳定，越高越有创意（0–2）。: Lower is more consistent, higher is more creative (0–2).
strings.单次回答的最大 token 数。: Maximum number of tokens in one reply.
strings.不使用工具时随问题发送的文档字符数。: Characters of the document sent with the question when tools are not used.
strings.附加在每次对话开头，例如回答风格、术语要求。: Added to the start of every chat, e.g. answer style or terminology.
strings.在输入框中键入 “/” 调出。命令只能包含字母、数字、汉字和连字符。: Type "/" in the message box to use them. Commands may contain letters, digits, Chinese characters and hyphens.
strings.为外部 AI 工具开放一组文档接口（OpenAPI 3.1），例如 Open W: Opens a set of document endpoints (OpenAPI 3.1) for external AI tools such as Open WebUI tool servers, scripts or agents. It listens only on 127.0.0.1 and every request must carry the token.
strings.外部程序以 Bearer 方式随请求发送。: External programs send it as a Bearer token.
strings.允许外部程序直接修改文档: Let external programs change documents without asking
strings.关闭时（推荐），外部程序每次写入都会在青页中弹出确认。: When off (recommended), Qingye asks you to confirm every write from an external program.
strings.留空则自动获取；多个用逗号分隔: Leave empty to fetch automatically; separate several with commas
strings.服务不提供模型列表时，可以手动填写模型名。: If the service does not list its models, type the model names here.
strings.本机服务通常不需要: Usually not needed for local services
strings.已保存 {hint}，留空保持不变: Saved {hint}; leave empty to keep it
strings.本机服务可以留空: Can be empty for local services
strings.导出文件是否包含 API Key？\n\n选择“确定”会以明文写入 Key，请妥:
Include API keys in the exported file?

OK writes the keys in plain text, so keep the file safe. Cancel exports only URLs and models.
strings.Open WebUI：设置 → 工具 → 添加连接（OpenAPI）: Open WebUI: Settings → Tools → Add connection (OpenAPI)
strings.API Key 使用系统凭据加密保存。: API keys are encrypted with the system credential store.
strings.当前系统不支持加密存储，API Key 以明文保存在本机配置文件中。: Encrypted storage is not available on this system; API keys are stored in plain text in the local settings file.
strings.找不到该文档或文档尚未加载：: Document not found or not loaded yet:
strings.只能写入 Markdown 文档；PDF 请使用批注或页面编辑。: Only Markdown documents can be written; for PDF use annotations or page editing.
strings.允许 AI 修改文档？: Let the AI change the document?
strings.允许外部程序新建文档？: Let an external program create a document?
strings.除非你启用 AI 协作并主动发送消息，青页不联网、不上传文档。阅读位置、最近文件: Qingye does not go online or upload documents unless you set up the AI assistant and send a message. Reading positions, recent files, draft backups and preferences stay on this computer.
strings.青页窗口未就绪。: The Qingye window is not ready.
strings.青页没有及时响应（可能在等待用户确认）。: Qingye did not respond in time (it may be waiting for the user to confirm).
strings.接口地址必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
strings.AI 连接不存在，请在设置中重新选择。: The AI connection no longer exists; choose one again in Settings.
strings.请先选择模型（设置 → AI 协作 → 获取模型列表）。: Choose a model first (Settings → AI Assistant → Fetch model list).
strings.已达到本轮工具调用次数上限，可以继续提问让 AI 接着完成。: Reached the tool-call limit for this turn; send another message to let the AI continue.
strings.窗口按钮的位置与样式。切换后重启青页生效。: Where the window buttons sit and how they look. Takes effect after restarting Qingye.
strings.右上角原生窗口按钮，紧凑直角: Native window buttons at the top right, compact square corners
strings.左上角红绿灯、统一标题栏: Traffic lights at the top left, unified title bar
strings.标题栏与首页透出模糊的桌面背景（Windows 11 亚克力材质）。: The title bar and the home page show the blurred desktop behind (Windows 11 acrylic).
strings.需要 Windows 11 22H2 或更高版本；当前系统不显示桌面背景。: Requires Windows 11 22H2 or later; on this system the desktop does not show through.
strings.新的界面风格将在重启青页后生效。: The new interface style takes effect after Qingye restarts.
strings.界面风格已保存，重启青页后生效: Interface style saved; restart Qingye to apply
strings.选择本地文档，转换为 Word、电子书、标记文本或 PDF。: Convert local documents to Word, ebooks, markup or PDF.
strings.每个输入生成独立文件。同名输出自动加数字后缀，已有文件不会被覆盖。取消保留已完成: Each input creates a separate file. Duplicate names get a numeric suffix; existing files are preserved. Canceling keeps completed files.
strings.请先选择输入文档和输出文件夹。: Choose input documents and an output folder first.
strings.部分转换失败，请查看结果: Some conversions failed; check the results
strings.内容已截断，回答可能未覆盖全文: Content is partial; the answer may not cover the full document
strings.引用文档已关闭，请重新打开原文。: The source document is closed. Reopen it first.
strings.引用位置已变化，请重新读取文档。: The source location has changed. Read the document again.
strings.多个输入文件会合并为一个输出文档。: Multiple input files are combined into one output document.
strings.本轮没有可用的目标文档，请打开文档后重新提问。: No target document is available for this turn. Open a document and ask again.
strings.程序正在关闭，不能开始新的转换。: The app is closing. A new conversion cannot be started.
strings.转换工作目录路径过长，请选择较短的目录。: The conversion working directory path is too long. Choose a shorter directory.
strings.Word / ODT 的页边距由参考文档决定；外部 PDF 排版使用引擎参数。: Word / ODT margins use the reference document; external PDF layout uses engine options.
strings.预览已截断，请确认完整内容后再接受修改。: Preview is truncated. Review the full content before accepting.
strings.原文已变化或关闭，请重新发起修改。: The original changed or closed. Request the change again.
strings.不能删除表头。: The header row cannot be deleted.
strings.表格已变化，请重新选择单元格。: The table changed. Select the cell again.
strings.可视化表格最多支持 200 行和 50 列。: Visual tables support up to 200 rows and 50 columns.
strings.文字识别完成，保存文档可保留文字层。: Recognition completed. Save to keep the text layer.
strings.文字识别已取消，未应用新的识别结果。: Recognition canceled; new results were not applied.
strings.请等待当前处理完成后再识别文字。: Wait for the current processing to finish before OCR.
strings.正在检查文字层，当前搜索结果可能不包含扫描页。: Checking text layers. Search results may omit scanned pages.
strings.当前未找到匹配内容；缺少文字层的页面尚未参与文字搜索，请先识别。: No matches yet. Pages without a text layer need recognition before searching.
strings.原 PDF 已关闭，请重新打开后定位。: The source PDF is closed. Reopen it to locate the annotation.
strings.原文档已关闭，无法返回阅读位置。: The document is closed; the reading position is unavailable.
strings.原文档已变化，请重新定位。: The source document changed. Locate it again.
strings.页码请使用 1-3,5 这样的格式。: Use a page range such as 1-3,5.
strings.识别页码超出文档范围。: OCR pages are outside the document range.
strings.预设格式不受当前引擎支持。: The engine does not support this preset format.
strings.预设高级参数过长。: Preset advanced options are too long.
strings.最多保存 30 个自定义预设。: Up to 30 custom presets can be saved.
strings.PDF 纸张或页边距参数无效。: Invalid PDF paper size or margins.
strings.批注笔记超过 32 MB，请减少选中的批注。: Annotation notes exceed 32 MB. Select fewer annotations.
strings.一次最多处理 100000 条批注。: Up to 100000 annotations can be processed at once.
strings.doi.org 没有这个 DOI 的记录。: doi.org has no record of this DOI.
strings.上次搭配的文档: The document it was last paired with
strings.上次搭配的文档不在最近列表中，请手动打开它。: The paired document is no longer in the recent list; open it manually.
strings.允许 AI 批注 PDF？: Allow AI to annotate the PDF?
strings.先打开一个 PDF 或 Markdown 文档，再进入笔记模式。: Open a PDF or Markdown document first, then enter notes mode.
strings.全库搜索的索引已重建: The library search index was rebuilt
strings.全库搜索：所有打开过的 PDF 和笔记 · Ctrl+Shift+F: Library search: every PDF and note you have opened · Ctrl+Shift+F
strings.删除索引并重新读取全部文档: Delete the index and read every document again
strings.区域摘录的图片保存在笔记旁的文件夹里，请先保存这份笔记。: Region pictures are stored in a folder beside the note. Save the note first.
strings.只把 DOI 发送到 doi.org 查询，其余内容不离开本机: Only the DOI is sent to doi.org; nothing else leaves this computer
strings.只能批注 PDF 文档；Markdown 请使用 insert_markdown: Only PDF documents can be annotated; use insert_markdown for Markdown.
strings.同一个文档不能同时放在左右两侧。: The same document cannot be on both sides.
strings.同步 PDF 批注到笔记: Sync PDF annotations into the note
strings.在 PDF 页面上拖动鼠标框选要摘录的区域 · Esc 取消: Drag on the PDF page to select the region to excerpt · Esc cancels
strings.已保存的引用信息，可以继续修改。: Saved reference details; you can keep editing them.
strings.已根据 PDF 内容识别，请核对后使用。识别在本机完成。: Detected from the PDF on this computer. Please check before use.
strings.已根据 PDF 内容重新识别引用信息: Reference details detected again from the PDF
strings.已用 doi.org 的记录补全，请核对。: Completed from the doi.org record. Please check it.
strings.把 PDF 批注同步到笔记: Sync PDF annotations into the note
strings.按 Enter 在所有文档的内容里搜索: Press Enter to search inside all documents
strings.搜索所有打开过的 PDF 和笔记；多个词用空格隔开，短语加引号: Search all opened PDFs and notes; separate words with spaces, quote phrases
strings.文档尚未加载完成，请稍后再试。: The document has not finished loading; try again in a moment.
strings.文档未能打开。: The document could not be opened.
strings.文献库还是空的。: The reference library is still empty.
strings.无法生成区域图片。: The region picture could not be created.
strings.无法连接 doi.org，请检查网络后重试。: Could not reach doi.org. Check the network and try again.
strings.框选区域摘录到笔记: Excerpt a region into the note
strings.框选区域摘录到笔记 · Ctrl+Shift+U: Excerpt a region into the note · Ctrl+Shift+U
strings.框选的区域太小，请重新拖动。: The selected region is too small. Drag again.
strings.滚动联动已开启：翻页时笔记跟到对应摘录: Scroll sync on: the note follows the page being read
strings.滚动联动：翻页时笔记跟到对应摘录: Scroll sync: the note follows to the excerpts of the page shown
strings.点击在 GB/T 7714 与 APA 之间切换: Click to switch between GB/T 7714 and APA
strings.笔记模式：AI 可以同时读取另一侧的文档: Notes mode: AI can also read the document on the other side
strings.笔记模式：左右双开 · Ctrl+\\: Notes mode: two documents side by side · Ctrl+\
strings.笔记模式：点击任一侧即可在其中操作；Ctrl+\\ 退出: Notes mode: click either side to work in it; Ctrl+\ leaves
strings.联网查询未完成，仍可手动填写。: The online lookup did not finish; you can still fill in the fields by hand.
strings.请先在 PDF 中选中要摘录的文字。: Select the text to excerpt in the PDF first.
strings.请先进入笔记模式，并在另一侧打开一份 Markdown 笔记。: Enter notes mode with a Markdown note on the other side first.
strings.输入关键词，在所有打开过的 PDF 和笔记里搜索: Type to search every PDF and note you have opened
strings.这个 PDF 有打开密码，未加入全库搜索。: This PDF needs a password and was left out of library search.
strings.这个文档已不在最近列表中。: This document is no longer in the recent list.
strings.这份 PDF 还没有批注: This PDF has no annotations yet
strings.在 Mac 上请到访达中选中一个 PDF 或 Markdown 文件，打开“显示: On a Mac, select a PDF or Markdown file in Finder, open "Get Info", choose Qingye PDF under "Open with", then click "Change All…".
strings.并排阅读与差异报告: Side by side and difference reports
strings.份最近文档，全在本机: recent documents, all on this computer
strings.打开一个 PDF，下次就能从这里接着读。: Open a PDF and you can pick up from here next time.
strings.拖入 PDF 直接打开: Drop a PDF to open it
strings.最近摘录 · 点页码回到原文: Recent excerpts · click a page to jump back
strings.在笔记模式里摘录 PDF 的句子，它们会出现在这里。: Excerpt sentences from a PDF in notes mode and they will appear here.
strings.最近的 PDF 里还没有书签。: The latest PDF has no bookmarks yet.
strings.这条摘录来自未保存的 PDF，无法跳回原处。: This excerpt comes from an unsaved PDF, so it can't jump back to the source.
strings.打开文件、搜索最近、运行工具…: Open files, search recent, run tools…
strings.PDF / MD · Ctrl+O · 或直接拖进来: PDF / MD · Ctrl+O · or drag it in
strings.桌上还空着。打开一个 PDF 或 Markdown，它会放到这里。: The desk is empty. Open a PDF or Markdown file and it will land here.
strings.打开一个 PDF 或 Markdown，它会出现在这里。: Open a PDF or Markdown file and it will appear here.
strings.点每行右侧的星标即可固定文件: Click the star at the right of a row to pin a file
strings.最近 17 周的阅读活动: Reading activity over the last 17 weeks
strings.打开过的文件所在的文件夹会列在这里: Folders of files you've opened will be listed here
strings.点来源跳回原处: Click a source to jump back
strings.磨砂玻璃，光随指针移动: Frosted glass; the light follows your pointer
strings.错版方格，悬停抬起、按下压印: Off-register tiles that lift on hover and press in on click
strings.文档像纸张摊在桌上，可拖动、会晃动: Documents spread on a desk like paper; drag them and they sway
strings.大色块拼贴，按压收缩、滑过放大: Big colour blocks that shrink when pressed and grow as you pass
strings.没有打开文档时看到的页面。立即生效，数据只在本机。: The page you see when no document is open. Applies at once; data stays on this computer.
strings.角色立绘主菜单，五个子页面带转场: Character art menu with five pages and transitions
strings.把多个 PDF 按顺序合成一个文件。: Combine several PDFs into one file, in order.
strings.把 PDF 拆成单页文件。: Split a PDF into single-page files.
strings.把扫描页和图片里的文字识别出来，支持中英文。: Recognise text in scanned pages and images, in Chinese and English.
strings.减小 PDF 体积，图片质量可调。: Make a PDF smaller; image quality is adjustable.
strings.给每一页加上文字水印。: Add a text watermark to every page.
strings.在指定位置盖上文字印章。: Place a text stamp where you choose.
strings.设置打开密码和权限。: Set an open password and permissions.
strings.加页码、页眉与页脚。: Add page numbers, headers and footers.
strings.并排比较两个版本。: Compare two versions side by side.
strings.PDF、Word、EPUB、Markdown 互相转换。: Convert between PDF, Word, EPUB and Markdown.
strings.打开 PDF 或 Markdown: Open a PDF or Markdown file
strings.也可以直接把文件拖进窗口。: You can also drag files into the window.

patterns: ^([\d,]+) 字 · 共 ([\d,]+) 行 · 点击查看字数统计$
$1 words · $2 lines · click for word count

Reopen the $1 tabs from last time

Registered program: $1. Register again after moving the exe.

Qingye PDF $1 · local open-source toolbox · no login, no subscription, no ads

Found a session that did not close normally: $1 ($2 drafts)

Line endings will change to $1 at the next save

Copied $1 images and updated the links · undoable

$1 custom themes in the themes folder; choose them from the "Theme" menu

Excerpted to $1 · can be undone, not saved yet
^已整理到 (.+) · 可撤销，尚未保存$
Added to $1 · can be undone, not saved yet
^已把第 (\d+) 页的区域摘录到 (.+) · 可撤销，尚未保存$
Region of page $1 excerpted into $2 · undoable, not saved yet
